Translation of a letter dated June 29, 1933, addressed
to Van Koh Wo(万国華), communist convict No. 3658 from
his father at Tungshan(東山), Hsuchowfu(徐州), Kiangsu.

Koh Hwa (国華) my son,

Since my return from Shanghai, all the members
of the family are well, so don't worry. The wheat
harvest this year is more abundant then that of last year.
The family will not encounter any financial difficulties.
Whenever you are in need of money you can write for it
at any time.

I engaged on farm work immediately after my
return and on this account I have not sent you any letter.
You have said you will send letters home but so far not a
single letter has been received from you. Therefore it is
expected you will write home when you get a chance of doing
so in order to pacify our worries.

I intend coming to see you again after the autumn
harvest. Be patient. Everything is quiet in the village
which is far more peaceful than last year. S Yeu(9岁) is
in the 3rd year class and will be in the 4th year class after
the summer vacation according to the teacher of the school
who says his knowledge is fair.

Father,
June 29.

徐州東車站南天橋
東利源粮棧

The following is the statement of Van Koh Yo, alias Siau Zeh, alias Tseng Foh Nyi, native of Kiangsu, Hsuchow, 25 years taken by me C.D.S.I. Yang Pei Sung, translated at Y'Poo Stn., on the 6-5-32 and interpreted by Clerk Loo.

I live at No. 50 Dah Chung Li, Kwensing Road, and am unmarried.
My native address is Fang Long Village (房村) Hsuchow (徐州) and the address of correspondence is Heng Li Food Store (亨利糧棧 south of Nan Tien Jao (南天橋), Eastern Railway Station (東車站) Hsuchow, in care of one Tsang Yah Nyi (張學義).
When I was 9 years of age, one named Zau Lau Fei (趙老會) taught me to read and write in my native place. At the age of 11, I attended the 3rd. primary school in Vung Miao (文廟), Dong Shan Hsien (銅山縣), Hsuchow. At the age of 15, I returned from that school and studied English in my home for about one year. Then I attended the 6th Middle School at Dzung Hsien (鄭縣), Shensi, through the introduction of one named Li Hang Zaior (李漢祥), who is one of my fellow countrymen and a graduate of that school. I graduated from that school in June of 1930, and the following month, returned to my native place. In August of the same year, I went to Peiping and entered the China Educational School (中國學院) Si Tah Bah Lur (西單牌樓), Peiping, the fare of the journey being supplied by my father. At Peiping, I rented a room in a boarding house near the school, and every day went to the school to study English. There I became acquainted with one of my class mates named Li Shing Nyi (李興義), a native of Shensi, about 21 years of age, who told me that the Chinese Government was very corrupt and that the Communist Party was well constituted and had great hope. I then, in Sept. of the same year, through his introduction, joined the communist party. He did not lead me to any communist organizations, but only told me that my work was to scatter pamphlets and introduce others to join the communist party. 由于我仍是学生，未加入任何商业机构。
我能读能写，教育程度为高中一年级。

Summarized translation of a draft of a letter, (undated) found
ON THE person of one Tsang Poh Nyi (张伯尼), who was arrested
on Thorburn Road at 9 a.m. May 1 in possession of a quantity
of communist literature.

I made a great mistake last year and was dismissed
from the Group (? Communist Youth Group). Prior to leaving
Shanghai, I sent a letter to you stating that this was all
due to circumstances, I do not know what decisions you have
reached as regards me. Having been away for more than a
year, I have come back to Shanghai again. Now I report to
you on the things that happened during that period and hope
you will establish connections with me and guide me in
political matters.

During April and May, last year, I, owing to
questions of my livelihood, left Shanghai. As I could not stay
at home, I went to Peiping, where I met Han Chuin (韩春) and
Chen Chih (陈志) and others. Although I made a "right-
leaning-mistake", I do not wish to leave the party or join the
small organizations (cells) of the 'right' clique. That
I did not engage in any activities in Peiping is simply due to
the fact that I could not locate the 6th Branch of the Group
or any revolutionary mass organizations. Sometime afterwards,
the Mancimurian imbroglio took place, and the social democrats
at Peiping became very active. Eddy, representative of the
2nd International, visited Peiping at the time. He delivered
speeches in various schools, and I directed many persons
to the venues to oppose him. Afterwards, I became aware
of my insufficient knowledge of politics and came to Shanghai.
However, owing to certain questions of livelihood, I went home.

After arrival in Shanghai, I met Li Ping (李平)
who still participated at that time in organizations of the
right party. As I could not find lodging, I just lived
with him, but opposed his participation in 'right leaning
organizations'. Later, I met Han Chmin (韩敏) and Chen Chih
(陈志). Li Ping and Han Chmin subsequently agreed to the
policy of the Elimination Clique and finally joined the organization
of that clique. I did not agree with them. I simply read
some documents and took no action. Soon afterwards I left
for home, but later returned to Shanghai.

Although I had no political or organizational connect-
ions with them, I was slightly influenced by them in
political matters because I lived with them. I now expect
you to correct my mistake.

Written on reverse side.

Brother Ya Ming (亚明)

One week has elapsed since you took away my
draft. Have you found any purchaser? As you have not
given me a reply, I am very anxious about it. Please
call at my house.

Siao Za (萧扎).
(13th day)

在张伯尼（Tsang Poh Nyi）身上搜获的一封信件草稿的摘要译文，该人于5月1日上午9时在韬朋路（Thorburn Road）被捕，当时持有大量共产党文献。（未注明日期）

去年我犯了严重错误，被团组织（？共产主义青年团）开除。在离开上海之前，我曾去信给你，说明这完全是由于环境所致，我不知道你们对我作出了什么决定。离家一年多后，我又回到了上海。现在我向你们汇报这段时间发生的事情，希望你们能与我恢复联系，并在政治上给予我指导。

去年四五月间，我因生计问题离开了上海。由于无法在家停留，我去了北平，在那里遇到了韩春（Han Chuin）和陈志（Chen Chih）等人。虽然我犯了“右倾错误”，但我不愿脱离党或加入“右”派的小组织（小组）。我在北平没有从事任何活动，仅仅是因为我找不到团的第六支部或任何革命群众组织。不久之后，发生了满洲事变，北平的社会民主党人变得非常活跃。第二国际的代表艾迪（Eddy）当时访问了北平。他在各学校发表演讲，我引导许多人去会场反对他。后来，我意识到自己政治知识不足，便来到上海。然而，由于某些生计问题，我回了家。

到达上海后，我遇到了李平（Li Ping），他当时仍参与右派组织的活动。由于找不到住处，我便与他同住，但反对他参与“右倾组织”。后来，我遇到了韩敏（Han Chmin）和陈志（Chen Chih）。李平和韩敏随后同意“取消派”的政策，并最终加入了该派的组织。我不同意他们的做法。我只是阅读了一些文件，没有采取任何行动。不久后我回了家，但后来又回到了上海。

虽然我与他们在政治或组织上没有联系，但由于与他们同住，我在政治问题上受到他们轻微的影响。现在我期望你们纠正我的错误。

写在背面。

亚明兄：

你拿走我的草稿已经一周了。找到买主了吗？由于你没有给我回复，我非常焦急。请来我家一趟。

萧扎（Siao Za）。
（13日）
